name: notification-stack
title: Notification Stack
description: Four notification banners land one after another and restack upward over a warm backdrop, then a dark end card with a two-line headline fades in.
useWhen: A product moment needs a burst of 'it happened' notifications ending on a brand end card.
The scene is a vertical social spot.
avoidWhen: You want a full chat or inbox: use chat-flow or messenger-chat-flow.
The banners should show a real app's name and look.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)
